Name: OD's Better Computer
Author: ODMods
Description:
[size=6]OD's Better Computer[/size]

Transforms the Farm Computer into a fully functional desktop interface with **21 built-in apps**.

[size=4]Features[/size]

- **Desktop Interface**: A complete desktop-style interface replacing the vanilla Farm Computer
- **21 Apps**: Everything you need to manage your farm life in one place
- **Notifications**: Reminders app sends popup notifications on the bottom left each morning

[size=4]Built-in Apps[/size]

| App | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| 📊 **Farm Dashboard** | Real-time overview: crops ready, animal status, machines (not used/working/ready), watering status |
| 👥 **Contacts** | Quick villager lookup with hearts and relationship info |
| 📅 **Calendar** | Full calendar with season navigation — browse any season's birthdays and festivals |
| 🌤️ **Weather** | Today's weather + tomorrow's forecast |
| 💕 **Relationships** | Track friendship levels, who you've talked to, gift status |
| 📈 **Statistics** | All player/farm stats — now works correctly with pre-existing/1.5 saves |
| 📬 **Mail** | Read your letters anytime |
| 🏛️ **Museum Tracker** | Donated items & missing items for the museum |
| 🏫 **Community Center** | Bundle tracker showing what's complete/incomplete |
| 🎣 **Fishing Log** | Fish caught, seasons, locations |
| 🌿 **Foraging Guide** | What's in season today, where to find it |
| ⛏️ **Mines Log** | Levels explored, items found |
| 🎁 **Gift Guide** | Loves/likes/dislikes for every villager, birthdays highlighted |
| 🍳 **Cooking** | Recipes learned, recipes you can cook today |
| 🗺️ **Farm Map** | Interactive farm map viewer |
| 📦 **Shipping History** | Items shipped & totals |
| 📝 **Notes** | Persistent notepad for your reminders |
| 📺 **TV Guide** | Queen of Sauce, Fortune Teller, weather — browse any day/season |
| 🔔 **Reminders** | Set reminders that pop up as notifications each morning, with filters for season, day, weekday, weather, birthdays, and repeat |
| ⚙️ **Settings** | Toggle individual apps on/off, boot animation toggle |

[size=4]Installation[/size]

1. Install [SMAPI 4.0+](https://smapi.io/)
2. Extract this mod folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder
3. Run the game using SMAPI
4. Craft or place a **Farm Computer** and interact with it

[size=4]Requirements[/size]

- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+

[size=4]How To Use[/size]

1. Place a Farm Computer on your farm (crafted with:
  - 1 Battery Pack
  - 10 Refined Quartz
  - 5 Gold Bars
  - 2 Iridium Bars
  - 1 Diamond
2. Left-click (or use your action button) while standing next to it
3. Click any app icon to launch
4. Use mouse wheel to scroll in apps
5. Press Escape or click X to close
[size=4]
Configuration[/size]

A `config.json` will be generated on first run. You can configure:
- `DisabledApps`: List of app IDs to hide from the desktop
- `BootAnimation`: `true`/`false` to toggle the boot animation
- `Notes`: Persistent text stored by the Notes app
- `Reminders`: List of reminders managed through the Reminders app

Or use the **Settings app** inside the computer to toggle apps visually!
[size=4]
For Mod Developers[/size]

This mod exposes an API to add your own custom apps! Use `IModRegistry.GetApi<IBetterComputerApi>()` and call `RegisterApp()`.

Implement the `IComputerApp` interface:

```csharp
public interface IComputerApp
{
    string Id { get; }
    string Name { get; }
    string ShortLabel { get; }
    Color IconColor { get; }
    Color IconTextColor { get; }

    void Open();
    void Draw(SpriteBatch b, Rectangle bounds);
    void DrawIcon(SpriteBatch b, Rectangle iconArea);
    void ReceiveLeftClick(int x, int y);
    void ReceiveScrollWheel(int direction);
    void PerformHoverAction(int x, int y);
    void ReceiveKeyPress(Keys key);
}
```

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

- Works with Stardew Valley 1.6
- Compatible with most mods that don't replace the Farm Computer interaction
- Multiplayer compatible (each player uses their own computer)
